rationale: Technical and Asset Officer in Lower Eyre Council's Works team: site inspections, footpath design, plans, quantities and cost estimates for minor works, coordinating resealing and footpath programs, and managing Before You Dig enquiries.

The advert welcomes recent engineering graduates and asks for a civil qualification or practical experience, working knowledge of roads, footpaths and drainage, plan reading, a Class C licence and a White Card; Marc's Advanced Diploma (road, pavement and stormwater design, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates) plus Philippines site inspections and coordination meet these at entry level.
Cummins SA is regional and interstate, so relocation is discussable only; basic surveying, GIS and asset data work are gaps.
caution: Interstate regional move to Cummins SA would need Marc's confirmation. No survey instrument or GIS software use on a job; project management experience is under one year.
gaps: No survey instrument or GIS software use on a job
Project coordination experience under one year (Philippines 2019 to 2020)
Relocation from Melton VIC to Cummins SA would need discussing
apply_instructions: Apply through SEEK; applications close 5.00pm Monday 2 November 2026. Enquiries by phone to the Director Infrastructure & Development, Brad-Lee Tolley, on 8676 0400.
